sections.heading: A Holistic Approach to Addiction Recovery

blocks.text: Ledgehill Treatment Centre is a leading provider of evidence-based addiction recovery treatment. They specialize in treating addiction, trauma, and mental health, using a holistic approach that aims to heal the person as a whole. The treatment programs are tailored to each client’s unique needs, incorporating individual counseling, physical exercise, and various types of therapy such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT). They also use 12-Step facilitation and relapse prevention to ensure long-term recovery.

centre.name: Ledgehill Treatment Centre
centre.about_html:
A Holistic Approach to Addiction Recovery

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is a leading provider of evidence-based addiction recovery treatment. They specialize in treating addiction, trauma, and mental health, using a holistic approach that aims to heal the person as a whole. The treatment programs are tailored to each client’s unique needs, incorporating individual counseling, physical exercise, and various types of therapy such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT). They also use 12-Step facilitation and relapse prevention to ensure long-term recovery.

 

Ledgehill Treatment Centre takes pride in its ability to provide long-lasting addiction recovery solutions to its clients. Their approach is based on an understanding that addiction is a complex issue that requires a multi-faceted solution. Their addiction recovery program is designed to target physical, psychological, and social factors that contribute to addiction.

Online and In-Person Addiction Recovery Programs

 

Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides four unique programs that cater to addiction and mental health: Return to Wellness, Mood and Anxiety, Family Treatment Support, and Addiction Recovery. The programs provide intensive outpatient support that is tailored to the patient’s specific needs, and clients can access them either in-person or online.

 

These programs are designed to offer flexible options for those who are unable to commit to a fully-residential addiction treatment program. Whether clients are struggling with an addiction to drugs, alcohol, or other addictive substances and behaviors, Ledgehill’s programs provide the support and guidance they need to overcome their addictions and live a healthier, happier life.

Finding Serenity in a Beautiful Location

 

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is tucked away in the serene and picturesque area of Lawrencetown, Nova Scotia, Canada. The facility is spread over 110-acres of land that includes fields, woods, and scenic shorelines. The property is coined, “the Ledge on the hill,” and has numerous quiet places and paths to explore.

 

Apart from offering a tranquil environment for addiction recovery, Ledgehill Treatment Centre also includes weekend recreational outings and nutritious meals on-site. Clients can relax in private or semi-private rooms that have en-suite bathrooms and enjoy the refreshing beauty of their surroundings, which can also help to improve their mental health.



Ledgehill Treatment Centre - Center Overview

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is dedicated to providing a safe and supportive environment for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health disorders. With an experienced team of medical professionals and therapists, the center offers a range of evidence-based treatments and therapies to suit each patient’s unique needs. From intensive group therapy sessions to one-on-one counseling and personalized treatment plans, Ledgehill Treatment Centre is committed to helping patients achieve lasting recovery.

Located in a beautiful natural setting, Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides a tranquil and peaceful environment for patients to focus on their recovery. The center boasts comfortable accommodations and a welcoming atmosphere, complete with cozy amenities that promote relaxation and healing. Here, patients can take advantage of the serene surroundings, access to outdoor activities, and dedicated staff who are available 24/7 to provide support and guidance throughout the recovery journey.

Frequently Asked Questions About Ledgehill Treatment Centre

What is the duration of the program?

The average duration of the program is seven weeks, but longer stays are available.

What types of therapy are offered?

Ledgehill Treatment Centre offers a range of therapies such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT).

What is the cost of treatment?

The cost of treatment depends on the individual’s needs and insurance coverage. Ledgehill accepts most private insurance.

Are the programs available online?

Yes, both online and in-person programs are available.

Are families welcome to visit?

Yes, family therapy is available, and families are welcome to visit with their loved ones.

A Holistic Approach to Addiction Recovery

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is a leading provider of evidence-based addiction recovery treatment. They specialize in treating addiction, trauma, and mental health, using a holistic approach that aims to heal the person as a whole. The treatment programs are tailored to each client’s unique needs, incorporating individual counseling, physical exercise, and various types of therapy such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT). They also use 12-Step facilitation and relapse prevention to ensure long-term recovery.

 

Ledgehill Treatment Centre takes pride in its ability to provide long-lasting addiction recovery solutions to its clients. Their approach is based on an understanding that addiction is a complex issue that requires a multi-faceted solution. Their addiction recovery program is designed to target physical, psychological, and social factors that contribute to addiction.

Online and In-Person Addiction Recovery Programs

 

Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides four unique programs that cater to addiction and mental health: Return to Wellness, Mood and Anxiety, Family Treatment Support, and Addiction Recovery. The programs provide intensive outpatient support that is tailored to the patient’s specific needs, and clients can access them either in-person or online.

 

These programs are designed to offer flexible options for those who are unable to commit to a fully-residential addiction treatment program. Whether clients are struggling with an addiction to drugs, alcohol, or other addictive substances and behaviors, Ledgehill’s programs provide the support and guidance they need to overcome their addictions and live a healthier, happier life.

Finding Serenity in a Beautiful Location

 

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is tucked away in the serene and picturesque area of Lawrencetown, Nova Scotia, Canada. The facility is spread over 110-acres of land that includes fields, woods, and scenic shorelines. The property is coined, “the Ledge on the hill,” and has numerous quiet places and paths to explore.

 

Apart from offering a tranquil environment for addiction recovery, Ledgehill Treatment Centre also includes weekend recreational outings and nutritious meals on-site. Clients can relax in private or semi-private rooms that have en-suite bathrooms and enjoy the refreshing beauty of their surroundings, which can also help to improve their mental health.



Ledgehill Treatment Centre - Center Overview

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is dedicated to providing a safe and supportive environment for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health disorders. With an experienced team of medical professionals and therapists, the center offers a range of evidence-based treatments and therapies to suit each patient’s unique needs. From intensive group therapy sessions to one-on-one counseling and personalized treatment plans, Ledgehill Treatment Centre is committed to helping patients achieve lasting recovery.

Located in a beautiful natural setting, Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides a tranquil and peaceful environment for patients to focus on their recovery. The center boasts comfortable accommodations and a welcoming atmosphere, complete with cozy amenities that promote relaxation and healing. Here, patients can take advantage of the serene surroundings, access to outdoor activities, and dedicated staff who are available 24/7 to provide support and guidance throughout the recovery journey.
